name: wood
backend: C++23 source to host native compiler

standard_output.failure_message: could not write to output stream
standard_output.linux_sigpipe: per-thread block/consume/restore; no global disposition change

evaluation_order: left-to-right; and/or and comparison chains short circuit; conditional expressions evaluate condition first and one branch

syntax.design_policy: distinctive Wood-native syntax and semantics; Python is a usability/capability reference
syntax.function_keyword_compatibility: def is contextual; existing identifiers remain legal
syntax.boolean_alias_compatibility: explicit bindings take precedence over True/False
syntax.comparison_chains: each reached operand evaluated once; short circuit; at most 255 operators
syntax.conditional_expression: yes if bool_condition else no; lazy branches; compatible static types; right associative

augmented_assignment.targets: existing variables and rooted record/list/dict paths
augmented_assignment.evaluation: target read before RHS; indexes once; store revalidates captured path
augmented_assignment.typing: checked binary result must be assignable to target's fixed type

syntax.slice_notation: string/list[start:stop:step]; optional integer bounds; nonzero signed step; clipped; value semantics; byte strings

comprehensions.clauses: nested for name in iterable and boolean if filters
comprehensions.scope: private binding per for; no leakage or reassignment of outer names
comprehensions.iteration: snapshot lists/strings/dict keys; direct range uses native cursor
comprehensions.dictionary_evaluation: key before value; last duplicate value, original insertion position
comprehensions.typing: homogeneous inferred/contextual result; parenthesize conditional iterables/filters

syntax.sequence_operations: same-element-type list concatenation; string/list integer repetition in either operand order; nonpositive counts empty; nested value isolation

variable_scope: lexical block; assignment updates an existing visible binding
function_scope: parameters and locals; no capture of script variables
implicit_conversion: None or compatible T to T | None

modules.exports: own functions and records without a leading underscore

initialization.target: absent or empty directory; default is current directory; linked targets rejected
initialization.name: normalize directory basename to ASCII identifier; fallback wood_app for invalid identifiers or std
initialization.existing_directory: preserved; non-overwriting copies with manifest last; partial new files may remain on I/O failure

packages.lock: wood.lock; compiler version, stdlib and transitive dependency source SHA-256

errors.syntax: try / except name / finally; raise string or error; bare raise in an except block re-raises
errors.constructor: error(code, message); code is 1..64 ASCII letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starts with a letter, not shaped like a wood code; otherwise R4003
errors.finally: runs on completion, return, break, continue and errors, then re-raises; cannot return, break or continue out (E3011, E3012); exit skips it; contextual keyword
errors.exit: unwinds to program entry; not intercepted by except

optional_standard_modules.runtime: optional dynamically loaded CPython 3.14, normal GIL, 64-bit

explain.failure: existing D5001 diagnostic; --diagnostics=json affects failures only
explain.storage: installed with wood; no project or native toolchain required
explain.catalog: codes lists the C++ reference's frozen subset; the native compiler reports its full catalog here, from docs/reference/explanations.md

diagnostics.positions: one-based byte columns; zero for unknown positions
diagnostics.identifier_suggestions: unique visible usable name; one edit or adjacent transposition; 3..64 byte names; same prefix for qualified functions
diagnostics.call_errors: expected parameter list or arity and provided count; named parameter context for ordinary declared argument type errors
diagnostics.type_errors: expected and actual types; value-expression locations for assignment, return, condition and default mismatches
diagnostics.message_stability: human-readable prose may improve; use code and source fields for automation

exit_codes.1: frontend error or failed test command

program_arguments: wood script.wd -- arguments; args() excludes executable/script name
not_implemented: explicit function type arguments, generic bounds and variadic type parameters
general union types, narrowing of fields and inside conditions, sets, tuple slices/iteration/order/concatenation, nested unpacking
variadic and unpacked call arguments; arbitrary default expressions
implicit truth testing and operand-returning boolean operators
classes, inheritance, bound method values and static methods
automatic Python call signatures, zero-copy Python arrays and bundled Python runtime
yield/coroutine generators, borrowing/reference captures and async iteration

records.declaration: record Name[T, ...]: typed fields and fn methods
records.constructor: required fields by position or keyword; inferred, contextual, or explicit Record[T](...)
records.mutation: rooted fields and nested container paths
records.recursive: through list/dict indirection; direct containment cycles rejected

json.semantics: immutable shared nodes; explicit typed conversion
json.utf8: strict for values; replacement in diagnostics
json.numbers: i64 integers and finite binary64; exact-kind equality

call_resolution.priority: explicit function/constructor/import bindings and local callable values, then builtin helpers
call_resolution.variables: new dict/json/slice callable names do not reserve variable names; historical builtin/type reservations retained

native_dependencies.standard_library: embedded Wood sources and C++ native primitives
native_dependencies.python_interop: design only; docs/python-distribution.md; no implemented bridge

process_limits.cleanup: Windows jobs; POSIX process groups; cooperative cancellation through driver signal handlers

inspection.type_refs: structural descriptors; nominal module/name identity; additive schema 1 fields

function_values.sources: own/imported/external functions; generic functions with concrete fn context; not builtins or constructors
function_values.call_interface: all parameters positional; names/defaults remain on named declarations
function_values.invocation: arbitrary function-valued expression; target then arguments, left-to-right

generics.syntax: fn name[T, U](value: T) -> U; def is an optional compatibility alias
generics.implementation: cached concrete native records and functions; bodies checked on instantiation
generics.inference: structural, repeated types invariant; contextual callbacks may defer until later argument types are known; runtime evaluation remains left-to-right

tuples.semantics: immutable heterogeneous values; nested value isolation
tuples.index: compile-time signed integer literal; negative indexes supported
tuples.unpacking: a, b = value and for a, b in values; tuples only, exact arity checked at compile time; no nesting or comprehension targets

optionals.syntax: T | None; None literal respects explicit bindings
optionals.unwrap: explicit copied payload; R4023 if absent
optionals.presence: is None / is not None; no implicit truthiness
optionals.narrowing: locals and parameters after is not None, in the else of is None, and after an is None body that never falls through; ends at assignment; no in-place changes while narrowed

calls.keywords: named functions, methods and record constructors; duplicate/unknown/missing keywords rejected
calls.defaults: side-effect-free literal values and containers; independent values per call
calls.evaluation: supplied arguments once in written order, then literal defaults

parameters: borrowed str -> const char*, int64_t byte_length
array[int] / array[float] -> const int64_t* / const double*, int64_t flat count
mut parameter: array[T] -> writable numeric pointer, int64_t flat count; rooted lvalue, contiguous, copy-on-write
ffi.callbacks: same thread, call duration only; first exception deferred until foreign return; zero/void fallback in C

filesystem.walk: iterative lexical depth-first; skips symlinks; whole result
filesystem.budget: all visited directory entries excluding root

canonical_paths.resolver: shared compiler link-aware canonicalization; missing suffix allowed only when requested
canonical_paths.identity: canonical UTF-8 slash path; ASCII lowercase on Windows, case-sensitive on POSIX
canonical_paths.within: canonical component containment including equality; existing root, possibly absent target

time.clock: C++ steady_clock; shared process-local origin initialized on first counter read
time.sleep: blocking; finite nonnegative seconds; positive fractional nanoseconds round up
time.resolution: platform dependent; nanosecond units do not imply nanosecond accuracy

resources.scope: with expression as name: suite; contextual keyword
resources.ownership: shared handle identity and cursor; close invalidates all aliases
resources.cleanup: scope: all control-flow exits; normal close failures reported; secondary unwind failures suppressed
resources.equality: identity; JSON and C FFI conversion rejected
resources.transaction_cleanup: rollback unless committed; nested savepoints finish in reverse order
resources.task_cleanup: cooperative cancel and blocking join; wait required to observe worker errors

networking.addressing: connect: OS DNS or numeric host; up to 64 family-interleaved candidates raced at 250 ms stagger; listen: explicit numeric address
networking.timeout_ms: 1..86400000; per logical read/line/write/accept/connect; DNS uses OS resolver policy
networking.cancellation: cooperative socket waits/retries: R4022; no preemption of OS DNS or arbitrary calls
networking.concurrent_use: one owner of an operation at a time; no thread safety guarantee
networking.http: bounded connection-close HTTP/1.x endpoint profile in Wood; docs/networking.md

tls_details.peer_verification: required client trust chain, validity, purpose and DNS/IP SAN
tls_details.trust_store: explicit PEM file or OpenSSL default roots
tls_details.fatal_error: connection unusable; subsequent I/O rejected; close releases without TLS shutdown
tls_details.close: close_notify, TCP write half-close, deadline-bound receive drain; unwinding aborts

sqlite.transaction: nested savepoints; rollback on scope exit unless committed
sqlite.query: bounded JSON rows; duplicate columns and blobs rejected

tasks.socket_transfer: consumes connection; invalidates all sender aliases
tasks.cancellation: cooperative stop token; SQLite progress and socket wait/retry checks; no forced I/O interruption
tasks.close: cancel and join; may block indefinitely
tasks.wait: bounded, repeatable result; original worker failure rethrown

methods.syntax: fn name(self, ...) or fn name(mut self, ...); optional additional [U, ...]
methods.mutable_receiver: rooted caller path, validated before arguments and reacquired after arguments; no escaping reference
methods.binding: immediate native calls; no bound method values

closures.syntax: fn [mut name, ...](x: T, ...) [-> R] => expression; capture list optional
closures.block_syntax: local fn name[mut capture](typed parameters) [-> R]: block; value result inferred, otherwise void
closures.capture: referenced locals captured as immutable owned value snapshots; explicit mut captures own mutable copies; resource handles retain identity
closures.concrete_representation: native struct and static call operator; no type erasure
closures.erased_representation: owned dispatch table; 32 bytes inline target storage if alignment fits and move is noexcept; heap otherwise
closures.mutable_call: rooted mutable path or owned temporary; target path reacquired after arguments
closures.parameters: explicit types or concrete callable context; expression result inferred
closures.defaults_keywords: concrete closures preserve names and literal defaults; erased callables use positional arguments
closures.c_abi: capturing closures cannot convert to fn pointers

native_computing.array: array[T] fixed shape; T is int64 or IEEE binary64; initialized contiguous ownership with strided COW snapshots
native_computing.shape: int, integer tuple of rank 1..8, or list[int]; dynamic rank/extents; nonnegative dimensions
native_computing.indexing: a[i,j] or a[(i,j)]; negative indexes; exact rank; checked reads/writes; len is total elements
native_computing.views: slice axis zero or num.slice for another axis; transpose permutation; shared owned snapshot, never mutable alias
native_computing.reshape: same element count; shares contiguous input, materializes strided input
native_computing.iteration: scalar values in logical row-major order; iterator protocol and comprehensions supported
native_computing.arithmetic: elementwise + - * /; equal shapes or scalar; scalar numeric promotions; checked int overflow and zero division; no multidimensional broadcasting
native_computing.reductions: sum and vector dot; Neumaier compensated finite float accumulation; int reductions checked
native_computing.conversion: num.floats and num.integers preserve shape; float-to-int truncates with finite/range checks; same-type conversion shares its value
native_computing.matmul: rank-two float matrices; validated pointer kernels preserving k order; host SIMD opportunities without fast-math
native_computing.affine: validated (n,3) float points and affine (4,4) matrix; fused native bulk transform
native_computing.ownership_optimization: read-only indexing borrows when index has no structural effects; reuse unique contiguous temporaries; conservative once-used owned locals in final top-level return; captures/closures/comprehensions/mutable foreign borrows excluded
native_computing.value_optimization: safe bounded internal borrows for read operands; owned string concatenation reuses buffers; final top-level returns can move once-used owned strings and scalar/string/array steps; resource/aggregate steps excluded; live values and iterator snapshots remain isolated; default assertions retain checks without constructing success-path messages
native_computing.loop_optimization: direct default/literal +1 and literal -1 range loops use native bounded induction; assignable user bindings stay separate; all other strides retain validated Range state
native_computing.linear_algebra: Wood Vec3, affine matrices/transforms, partial-pivoted multi-RHS solve with finite inputs and relative pivot rejection
native_computing.geometry: Wood triangle mesh validation, torus, normals, area, bounds, transforms and OBJ export

obj_import.implementation: native Wood over scoped streams, lists and numeric arrays
obj_import.indices: independent one-based positive or relative negative vertex/normal indices; already defined records only; consistent corner syntax per face
obj_import.normals: finite values and references validated, discarded; existing exporter recomputes geometry normals

return_inference.syntax: omit -> R on fn declarations, methods or local functions
return_inference.scope: definition-module environment; concrete generic specialization; no caller-dependent ordinary result inference
return_inference.joins: identical types; int/float becomes float; T and None becomes T | None; optional numeric joins require every original return to be assignable
return_inference.no_value_returns: void; extern declarations without an arrow remain void
return_inference.control_flow: every path must return or raise for a value result; no implicit None; loops conservatively may not execute
return_inference.recursion: return dependency cycles require a return annotation on at least one participating function
return_inference.concrete_closures: factories retain concrete owned closure types without implicit callable erasure
return_inference.context_limits: empty literals and finished() require an annotation/context; distinct nominal closure/record types do not unify; no container covariance

native_optimization.range: unsigned distance/stride count computed once; signed advance only when another representable item remains
native_optimization.borrow_lifetime: single call only; outputs retain existing scalar/owned value semantics

iterators.protocol: fn iter(self) -> CursorType; fn next(mut self) -> step[T]; no extra method arguments/type parameters
iterators.step: yielded(value) or finished(); has_item and checked step_value; None is a valid present item
iterators.loop_semantics: owned cursor snapshot; explicit next mutates the rooted cursor; shared stream handles advance shared resource
iterators.dispatch: concrete native calls; no erased iterator interface, coroutine frame or intermediate list
iterators.callable_pattern: F(A,...) [-> R] retains concrete callback type F
iterators.stream_ownership: caller-owned with scope; lines retains LF and uses explicit byte budget
